gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: MJD values for dates around the 1972-12-31 leap second
ADDED i2: Test data columns: baseMjd – MJD of the starting instant baseNanos – nano-of-day of the starting instant newMjd – argument passed to withModifiedJulianDay() exp
ADDED i3: Ordinary days: nanos are preserved regardless of which MJD the instant moves to
ADDED i4: Leap-second nanos (NANOS_PER_DAY) carried into a non-leap day → DateTimeException
ADDED i5: Leap-second nanos carried into another leap day → valid
